messages:
alisa: heads-up — planning a least-priv rollout for the namespace provisioner this week. current: provisioner SA has a cluster-wide deploy role, including ability to bind nodepools. goal: restrict to ns-scoped Role and create a small ClusterRole for nodepool controller. any gotchas w/ KMS unwrap and audit retention?

mike: +1. curious if the provisioner still needs secrets/get across namespaces for token exchange? that was the reason for broad perms originally.

alisa: it needs to create serviceaccount + secret in target ns and write a bootstrap secret. so Role should allow create/patch/update secrets in the target ns but not list/get across all namespaces. avoid cross-ns list.

jen-security: watch the KMS decrypt path. today the provisioner calls KMS via a helper in infra namespace that has kms:decrypt IAM. if we switch helper pattern, KMS IAM bindings must reflect new SA. otherwise decrypts will 403 and pods fail to start.

tom-sre: how is the helper invoked? our mutating webhook calls an `infra-unwrapper` service to unwrap tokens. RBAC changes will require webhook serviceAccount/name changes.

alisa: sketched plan:
1) Add Role `ns-provisioner` (namespace) with verbs: create, patch, update, get for secrets and serviceaccounts; create rolebindings in that ns only.
2) Add ClusterRole `nodepool-provision` limited to nodepool CRD read/update and no clusterrolebinding verbs.
3) Create ServiceAccount `kms-unwrapper` in infra ns with only IAM kms:decrypt and no cluster rolebinding privileges.

Role snippet:```
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: ns-provisioner
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets","serviceaccounts"]
  verbs: ["create","patch","update","get"]
- apiGroups: ["rbac.authorization.k8s.io"]
  resources: ["rolebindings"]
  verbs: ["create","get"]
```

mike: looks good. for kms-unwrapper IAM role — are we logging decrypts? we should produce structured audit entries for decrypt, keyed by caller SA.

jen-security: yes. require the unwrapper to emit structured logs: fields `caller_sa`, `target_ns`, `reason`. push to long-retention compliance sink and alert on spikes (e.g., >50 decrypts/min for a single SA).

deploy-bot: [automated] staging rollout plan created: canary 10% (3 namespaces), wait 30m, validate pods boot and no KMS errors. Cmd: `./deploy rollout ns-provisioner --canary=3 --wait=30m`

tom-sre: contingency: if KMS decrypt fails after rollout, fallback = rebind old clusterrole for provisioner and rollback. make rollback idempotent. add feature flag `provisioner_rbac_v2` to toggle.

alisa: agree. also update kube-audit policy to capture create on secrets but redact secret.requestObject in public streams — only keep metadata+subject.

jen-security: +1 on redaction. request infra-appsec review because some CI jobs historically assumed cluster-wide SA tokens.

mike: i'll run preflight scans for cross-ns secret access by provisioner SA. quick check: `kubectl auth can-i get secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:infra:ns-provisioner -n other-ns` across samples.

alisa: timeline: PR branch today, infra-appsec review tomorrow, canary rollout Thurs AM, wide Fri night if no alerts. tagging @jen-security @tom-sre @mike

jen-security: I'll review PR and add audit rule for decrypt events and a runbook entry for KMS-decrypt-failure -> rollback.

tom-sre: will update webhook manifests to reference `kms-unwrapper` SA and add readiness probe to fail fast on unwrap 403.

mike: confirm `nodepool-provision` ClusterRole does NOT include create on clusterrolebindings — that was our previous blast radius.

alisa: omission is intentional. pushing PR with YAMLs + rollback playbook + unit test that simulates `kubectl auth can-i`.

kms-audit-bot: [info] suggested audit rule: {"action":"ALLOW_DECRYPT_AUDIT","match":{"service":"kms","operation":"Decrypt","subject":"*"},"sink":"s3://compliance-audit/kms-decrypts/"}

jen-security: perfect. require encrypt-context enforcement on decrypts: `context.caller_sa` must be set.

tom-sre: LGTM, will watch canary.

mike: preflight scan passed for sampled namespaces — no cross-ns secret.get found.

alisa: rolling canary in 10m :rocket:

deploy-bot: [automated] canary rollout started for ns-provisioner_v2 — 3 namespaces targeted.

jen-security: monitoring decrypt metrics and compliance sink — will alert if anomalous.

mike: small docs nit — add expected service account names so infra code doesn't assume old clusterrole.

alisa: added to PR. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 contains role/clusterrole/webhook changes and rollback scripts. please review.

mike: checking now.

jen-security: reviewed; added comment about encrypt-context enforcement.

tom-sre: noted. will monitor and update runbooks if needed.

alisa: thanks all. will proceed with canary and close thread after wide rollout success.
